l4s.name: Billing mode setup and premium notice generation

steps.name: Establish Billing Account & Modal Premium Schedule
steps.description: On policy issue, create the billing account, set the premium mode (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly) and modal factors, identify the payor (owner, assignee, or third party), and set the first premium due date in the billing system.
steps.supporting: Policy Issue Specialist, New Business Case Manager
steps.inputs: Issued policy record, premium mode election, payor and owner details, modal factor tables
steps.outputs: Billing account, modal premium schedule, first premium due date

steps.name: Set Up EFT Draft & Recurring Payment Authorizations
steps.description: Validate signed ACH/EFT authorizations per NACHA rules, pre-note the bank account, schedule the recurring monthly draft date, and store the authorization record for dispute defense.
steps.supporting: Cash Application / Billing Specialist, Payment Processing Clerk
steps.inputs: Signed EFT authorization form, bank account details, draft date election, pre-note results
steps.outputs: Validated EFT authorization record, scheduled recurring draft, pre-note exceptions

steps.name: Configure List Bill & Payroll Deduction Arrangements
steps.description: Set up employer list bill groups and payroll deduction slots for worksite life and disability coverage: load the employee census, agree the remittance calendar with the employer, and map deduction amounts to individual policies.
steps.inputs: Employer list bill agreement, employee census, payroll deduction schedule, policy-to-employee mapping
steps.outputs: List bill group account, payroll deduction slots, agreed remittance calendar

steps.name: Generate & Distribute Premium Notices
steps.description: Produce and mail/e-deliver premium due notices within statutory timing windows (e.g., NY Ins. Law 3211 requires notice 15-45 days before the due date for scheduled-premium policies) plus consolidated list bill statements, honoring third-party designee and assignee notification elections.
steps.supporting: Policy Issuance / Document Fulfillment Specialist, Compliance Analyst
steps.inputs: Modal premium schedule, billing calendar, state notice timing rules, policyowner contact and designee elections
steps.outputs: Premium due notices, list bill statements, e-bill notifications, notice mailing proof

steps.name: Process Billing Mode & Payor Changes
steps.description: Handle in-force requests to change premium mode, draft date, payor, or billing channel: verify owner authority, recalculate modal premium and factors, and confirm the change to the owner in writing.
steps.inputs: Mode or payor change request, identity and authority verification, modal factor tables
steps.outputs: Updated billing schedule, recalculated modal premium, change confirmation letter

l4s.name: Premium collection and flexible premium processing

steps.name: Execute Scheduled EFT Drafts & Receive Remittance Files
steps.description: Generate and transmit the daily ACH draft file for scheduled premiums, receive bank acknowledgements and employer payroll remittance files, and log collected cash to the premium clearing account.
steps.inputs: Scheduled draft file, payroll remittance files, bank acknowledgement files
steps.outputs: Collected premium cash, draft exception list, clearing account postings

steps.name: Reconcile List Bill Remittances to Billed Census
steps.description: Match each employer remittance to the billed list bill statement at employee level, identify census changes (terminations, new enrollees, salary-driven amount changes), and chase shortages or unidentified employees with the employer.
steps.inputs: Employer remittance detail, list bill statement, census change feeds
steps.outputs: Matched remittance, census discrepancy report, employer follow-up requests

steps.name: Apply Premiums to Policy & Contract Records
steps.description: Post matched premium receipts to individual policy records, advance paid-to dates, allocate split payments across riders and coverages, and produce the daily premium application register for control sign-off.
steps.supporting: Life Policy Service Representative, AR Reconciliation Analyst
steps.inputs: Collected premium cash, matched remittances, policy billing records
steps.outputs: Posted premium transactions, updated paid-to dates, unapplied receipt list

steps.name: Process Flexible Premium Payments & Test Tax Qualification Limits
steps.description: Apply unscheduled universal life flexible premiums after testing against IRC 7702 guideline premium limits and the IRC 7702A seven-pay (MEC) test; deduct premium loads, refund or hold premium in excess of limits, and notify the owner where a payment would create a Modified Endowment Contract.
steps.inputs: Unscheduled flexible premium receipt, guideline premium and seven-pay limits, policy account values
steps.outputs: Applied flexible premium net of loads, MEC test result, excess premium refund trigger, owner MEC notification

steps.name: Handle Returned Payments & NSF Reversals
steps.description: Process bank return files (NSF, closed account, dispute): reverse the premium posting, roll back the paid-to date, schedule a retry draft where authorized, and issue returned-payment letters before delinquency processing starts.
steps.inputs: Bank return file, NSF notifications, posted premium transactions, retry authorization rules
steps.outputs: Reversed premium postings, retry drafts, returned-payment letters, delinquency referrals

l4s.name: Grace period, lapse and reinstatement billing

steps.name: Identify Past-Due Premiums & Start Grace Period
steps.description: Detect unpaid premiums at due date, start the contractual grace period (31 days for scheduled-premium policies; 61 days from the insufficiency determination for flexible-premium policies per NY Ins. Law 3211/3203), and build the daily past-due policy worklist.
steps.supporting: Billing Coordinator, Life Policy Service Representative
steps.inputs: Paid-to dates, unpaid premium records, net cash surrender value insufficiency tests, grace period provisions
steps.outputs: Grace period start records, past-due policy list, insufficiency determinations

steps.name: Issue Statutory Grace & Pending Lapse Notices
steps.description: Generate grace and pending-lapse notices that meet state content and timing rules (amount due, due date, lapse consequence; for flexible-premium policies the NY 3211(a)(1) insufficiency notice must be mailed no earlier than, and within 30 days after, the insufficiency determination), mail to the owner and any written third-party designee or assignee (senior-protection designee laws), and retain proof of mailing to defend later lapse contests.
steps.supporting: Compliance Analyst, Life Policy Service Representative
steps.inputs: Past-due policy list, state notice timing and content rules, insufficiency determinations, third-party designee and assignee elections
steps.outputs: Grace period notices, pending lapse notices, designee notifications, proof-of-mailing records

steps.name: Apply Waiver of Premium for Approved Disability Claims
steps.description: For policies with an approved waiver-of-premium disability claim, suspend billing, credit waived premiums to keep the policy in force, refund premiums paid during the retroactive waiver period, and diarize continuing-disability reviews with the claims team.
steps.inputs: Approved waiver-of-premium claim, policy billing record, disability continuance evidence
steps.outputs: Suspended billing, waived premium credits, retroactive premium refunds, waiver review diary

steps.name: Process Automatic Premium Loans & Nonforfeiture Elections
steps.description: When grace expires unpaid on cash-value policies, apply the automatic premium loan if elected, or apply the standard nonforfeiture options (reduced paid-up, extended term, cash surrender) per the Standard Nonforfeiture Law, updating policy status and values accordingly.
steps.inputs: Unpaid premium at grace expiry, cash value and loan balances, APL election, nonforfeiture provisions
steps.outputs: Automatic premium loan transactions, reduced paid-up or extended term conversions, updated policy status and values

steps.name: Lapse Policy & Quote Reinstatement Requirements
steps.description: Terminate coverage when grace and nonforfeiture options are exhausted, record the lapse with its notice audit trail, and on reinstatement request quote back premiums with interest and route evidence-of-insurability requirements to underwriting before billing resumes.
steps.inputs: Expired grace period, lapse rules, reinstatement application, back premium and interest calculations
steps.outputs: Lapsed policy status, reinstatement quote, evidence-of-insurability referral, reinstated billing schedule

steps.name: Receive & Validate Purchase Payment Instructions
steps.description: Accept initial and subsequent purchase payments on deferred annuity contracts (check, wire, ACH, 1035 exchange proceeds), confirm the contract accepts additional payments, verify good order, and confirm receipt date for interest-crediting purposes.
steps.supporting: Cash Application Specialist, Payment Processing Clerk
steps.inputs: Purchase payment remittance, contract record and payment provisions, owner instructions, 1035 exchange proceeds
steps.outputs: Validated payment instruction, good-order confirmation, receipt date record

steps.name: Apply Best-Interest Review Triggers for Additional Payments
steps.description: Where a subsequent purchase payment results from a producer recommendation, apply the NAIC Model #275 best-interest review (care, disclosure, conflict, documentation) and contract premium-limit checks before acceptance; route flagged payments to suitability escalation.
steps.inputs: Validated payment instruction, producer recommendation indicator, consumer suitability profile, contract premium limits
steps.outputs: Best-interest clearance, escalated suitability cases, declined or returned payments

steps.name: Verify Qualified Contribution Limits & Tax Year Coding
steps.description: For IRA and other qualified annuity payments, test against IRS contribution limits (IRC 408 IRA limits, catch-up eligibility), capture the owner's tax-year designation, and flag excess contributions for corrective distribution.
steps.inputs: Cleared purchase payment, IRS contribution limits, owner tax-year designation, prior-year contribution history
steps.outputs: Limit-validated contribution, tax-year coding, excess contribution flags

steps.name: Allocate Purchase Payment to Subaccounts & Crediting Options
steps.description: Invest the payment per the allocation instructions on file — variable subaccounts at the applicable unit values, fixed and indexed crediting options at current rates and cap/participation terms — and record units purchased and any premium bonus.
steps.supporting: Investment Operations Manager, Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist
steps.inputs: Limit-validated contribution, allocation instructions on file, unit values, crediting rates and index terms
steps.outputs: Allocated purchase payment, units purchased, applied premium bonus, allocation exceptions

steps.name: Issue Confirmations & Accrue State Premium Tax
steps.description: Update accumulation values, issue the owner transaction confirmation, and accrue front-end state annuity premium tax where the situs state taxes annuity considerations at receipt rather than annuitization.
steps.inputs: Allocated purchase payment, contract values, state premium tax rules by situs
steps.outputs: Updated accumulation value, owner confirmation notice, state premium tax accrual, transaction audit record

steps.name: Receive Plan Sponsor Contribution & Census Files
steps.description: Ingest payroll-cycle contribution files and participant census updates from plan sponsors of group annuity and recordkept retirement plans, validate file format and totals, and reconcile headcount against the prior census.
steps.inputs: Payroll contribution file, participant census updates, plan remittance schedule, prior census
steps.outputs: Validated contribution file, census mismatch report, file rejection notices

steps.name: Validate Contributions Against Plan Rules & IRS Limits
steps.description: Test each participant's deferrals and employer contributions against the plan document (eligibility, match formula, source coding) and IRS limits — IRC 402(g) elective deferral, 415 annual additions, catch-up — flagging excess deferrals for corrective distribution.
steps.inputs: Validated contribution file, plan document provisions, IRS 402(g) and 415 limits, year-to-date contribution history
steps.outputs: Limit-tested contributions, excess deferral flags, plan-rule exception report

steps.name: Monitor Remittance Timeliness Against DOL Standards
steps.description: Track each remittance from payroll date to deposit against ERISA plan-asset rules (29 CFR 2510.3-102, including the 7-business-day small-plan safe harbor), log late remittances as potential prohibited transactions, and refer them for lost-earnings correction (VFCP) and Form 5500 reporting.
steps.inputs: Payroll dates, remittance receipt dates, DOL safe-harbor and plan-asset rules
steps.outputs: Remittance timeliness log, late remittance findings, lost-earnings correction referrals, sponsor notifications

steps.name: Allocate Contributions to Participant Accounts & Investments
steps.description: Post limit-tested contributions to participant accounts by money source (pre-tax, Roth, match, profit sharing), invest per participant elections or the plan default (QDIA) at the day's unit values, and report allocation results to the sponsor.
steps.supporting: Investment Operations Manager, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Limit-tested contributions, participant investment elections, plan default investment, unit values
steps.outputs: Allocated participant contributions, purchased units by source, allocation exception list

steps.name: Reconcile Plan Remittances & Resolve Allocation Breaks
steps.description: Reconcile bank deposits to allocated contributions at plan level, clear residual plan-cash balances, resolve participant-level allocation breaks, and issue discrepancy notices to sponsors for shortages or unidentified participants.
steps.supporting: Cash Application Specialist, AR Reconciliation Analyst
steps.inputs: Bank deposit detail, allocated contribution totals, plan-level cash account balances
steps.outputs: Reconciled plan remittance, allocation break resolutions, sponsor discrepancy notices

l3s.name: Life & Annuity Premium Suspense & Refund Management

steps.name: Log Cash-with-Application & Unallocated Receipts to Suspense
steps.description: Hold cash-with-application premiums in suspense pending the underwriting decision, tracking any conditional-receipt coverage the deposit triggers, and move other receipts that cannot be matched to a policy, contract, or plan (missing policy number, list bill overage, premiums received after lapse or death) into the premium suspense ledger with reason codes and aging start dates.
steps.supporting: Cash Application / Billing Specialist, New Business Case Manager
steps.inputs: Cash-with-application receipts, conditional receipt terms, unmatched receipts, bank deposit detail, policy lookup results, suspense reason codes
steps.outputs: Suspense ledger entries with conditional-receipt flags, reason-coded items, aging start dates

steps.name: Research & Match Suspense Items to Policies
steps.description: Work life, annuity and retirement suspense items daily: contact payors and producers, match items against pending new business and recently issued policies and contracts, and apply resolved funds to the correct policy or plan with corrected paid-to dates. Generic receivable suspense research for the shared P&C billing book remains with CI-01-02 (Research Suspense Items / Resolve & Clear Suspense).
steps.supporting: Life Policy Service Representative, Annuity Service Specialist
steps.inputs: Suspense ledger entries, policy and contract records, pending new business queue, payor correspondence
steps.outputs: Matched and applied suspense items, corrected paid-to dates, unresolved item list

steps.name: Age Suspense & Escalate Stale Items
steps.description: Produce the periodic suspense aging report for life, annuity and retirement money, enforce resolution SLAs by reason code, escalate items breaching age thresholds to management, and classify stale items as return-to-payor or escheatment-referral candidates.
steps.supporting: Billing Operations Manager, Cash Application Specialist
steps.inputs: Suspense ledger, aging thresholds by reason code, resolution SLA rules
steps.outputs: Suspense aging report, stale item escalations, return-to-payor candidates, escheatment referral candidates

steps.name: Return Unresolvable Funds or Refer for Escheatment
steps.description: Return unresolvable funds to the payor where a valid address or bank account exists; otherwise package dormant items with due-diligence history and hand off to the Finance unclaimed-property process (F-11-05) for owner due diligence, state reporting and remittance — escheatment itself is not performed here, and stale-item monitoring for the shared P&C receivables book stays in CI-01-02-S07.
steps.inputs: Return-to-payor candidates, escheatment referral candidates, payor banking and address details, due-diligence history
steps.outputs: Returned funds, escheatment handoff package to Finance, closed suspense items

steps.name: Identify Refund Triggers & Calculate Refund Amounts
steps.description: Detect line-specific refund events — free-look cancellations (10-30 day state right to return with full or account-value refund), premiums in excess of IRC 7702/7702A limits (returnable with interest within 60 days after the end of the contract year to cure MEC status per 7702A(e)(1)(B); refunded interest is taxable to the owner), cash-with-application returns on declined, withdrawn or incomplete applications, duplicate or overpaid premiums, and premiums received after lapse or death — and calculate the refund due.
steps.supporting: Life Policy Service Representative, Actuarial Analyst
steps.inputs: Free-look cancellation requests, excess premium flags, declined and withdrawn application list, overpayment and duplicate payment reports, post-lapse and post-death receipts
steps.outputs: Refund calculations, refund queue, refund reason codes

steps.name: Approve Refunds & Validate Payee Entitlement
steps.description: Apply dollar-threshold approval authority, verify the refund payee is the entitled party (owner, premium payor, or estate), and reject or escalate refunds with entitlement conflicts, assignments, or fraud indicators.
steps.inputs: Refund calculations, payee entitlement records, assignment and lien data, approval authority thresholds
steps.outputs: Approved refunds, rejected or escalated items, entitlement documentation

steps.name: Package & Transmit Approved Refunds for Screened Disbursement
steps.description: Build the line-coded refund file — free-look values, MEC excess with credited interest, cash-with-application returns — and transmit it to the shared premium-refund disbursement process (CI-01-02-S06 'Process Premium Refunds & Screen Disbursements'), which issues ACH/check payments and performs the point-of-release OFAC screening backed by RC-20-05; receive back disbursement confirmations and blocked-payment notifications and update the refund cases.
steps.supporting: Cash Application / Billing Specialist, Compliance Analyst
steps.inputs: Approved refunds, payee banking details, refund reason codes, returned disbursement and blocked-payment confirmations
steps.outputs: Transmitted refund disbursement file, disbursement confirmations, blocked-payment escalations to financial crime, updated refund cases

steps.name: Record Refunds & Adjust Policy and Tax Records
steps.description: Reverse the refunded premium from policy history, restore correct guideline premium and seven-pay test positions, post the accounting entries, and adjust tax reporting records where the refund changes reportable amounts.
steps.inputs: Disbursed refunds, policy premium history, guideline premium and seven-pay records, tax reporting rules
steps.outputs: Reversed premium postings, adjusted MEC and guideline premium records, accounting entries, tax reporting adjustments
