steps.name: Receive & Index Annuity Application
steps.description: Receive the signed annuity application package from the producer or direct channel, index documents to a new business case, confirm product availability and state approval for the applicant's situs state, and assign the case for processing.
steps.supporting: Policy Data Entry Clerk, Annuity Service Specialist
steps.inputs: Signed annuity application, producer submission package, product availability and state approval matrix
steps.outputs: Indexed new business case, case assignment, application receipt acknowledgment

steps.name: Verify Producer License, Appointment & Product Training
steps.description: Confirm the writing producer holds an active license and carrier appointment in the application state and has completed the annuity product-specific and best-interest training required by NAIC Model #275 before the recommendation date.
steps.inputs: Producer license record, carrier appointment data, NAIC #275 product and best-interest training completions
steps.outputs: Producer authorization confirmation, training compliance flag, hold-or-proceed decision

steps.name: Perform Good-Order & Required-Disclosure Review
steps.description: Review the application for completeness and signature integrity, verify all state-required forms are present (buyer's guide and disclosure document acknowledgments per NAIC Model #245, fraud warnings, ownership/annuitant designations), and render a good-order or not-in-good-order determination.
steps.inputs: Application forms, buyer's guide and disclosure acknowledgments, state forms requirement matrix, signature and witness rules
steps.outputs: Good-order determination, NIGO defect list, documented forms checklist

steps.name: Resolve Not-in-Good-Order Items
steps.description: Communicate NIGO defects to the producer and applicant, track outstanding requirements against cycle-time and rate-lock aging thresholds, receive and validate cures, and close or withdraw cases that exceed the requirement aging window.
steps.supporting: Broker Support Specialist, Annuity Service Specialist
steps.inputs: NIGO defect list, producer and applicant contact details, requirement aging thresholds
steps.outputs: Cured application items, requirement follow-up log, withdrawn or closed incomplete cases

steps.name: Confirm Initial Premium Receipt & Rate Lock
steps.description: Confirm receipt and clearance of the initial premium or pending transfer indicator, apply the product's rate-lock rules to set the credited-rate guarantee window, post the premium to suspense pending issue, and refer cash-equivalent, third-party-funded or other source-of-funds red flags to the enterprise financial-crime program (annuities are covered products under FinCEN's insurer AML rule).
steps.supporting: Payment Processing Clerk, Billing Operations Manager
steps.inputs: Initial premium payment, transfer-pending indicators, rate-lock window rules, suspense account procedures, AML source-of-funds red-flag indicators
steps.outputs: Premium receipt confirmation, rate-lock effective date, suspense posting record, AML referral where flagged

steps.name: Compile Consumer Profile & Financial Information
steps.description: Assemble the consumer profile information required by NAIC Model #275 — age, income, financial situation and needs, tax status, investment objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity needs, time horizon, and existing insurance/annuity holdings — and verify the profile form is complete and internally consistent.
steps.inputs: Consumer profile information form, financial and tax status details, investment objectives and risk tolerance, liquidity and time-horizon needs
steps.outputs: Completed consumer profile record, consistency check results, missing-information requests

steps.name: Evaluate Recommendation Against Best-Interest Obligations
steps.description: Assess the producer's recommendation against the four NAIC Model #275 best-interest obligations — care, disclosure, conflict of interest, and documentation — confirming the product, riders and funding amount reasonably address the consumer's profile and that the basis of recommendation is documented.
steps.inputs: Consumer profile record, producer recommendation and basis documentation, product features and surrender schedule, compensation disclosure forms
steps.outputs: Suitability determination, documented basis of recommendation, conditions or information requests

steps.name: Review Replacement Activity & Disclosures
steps.description: Identify replacement transactions, validate replacement notice and comparison forms per NAIC Model #613, compare surrender charges, lost benefits and new surrender periods against the gains of the proposed contract, and confirm replacement-specific best-interest analysis is documented before issue.
steps.supporting: Compliance Analyst, New Business Case Manager
steps.inputs: Replacement disclosure and comparison forms, existing contract values and surrender charges, lost-benefit analysis, ceding carrier notification requirements
steps.outputs: Replacement compliance confirmation, ceding carrier notices, comparison documentation

steps.name: Escalate or Decline Unsuitable Cases
steps.description: Route recommendations that fail the best-interest review to senior compliance review, document the rationale for decline or conditional approval, notify the producer and applicant, and refund premium on declined cases.
steps.inputs: Failed suitability determinations, escalation criteria, producer conduct history
steps.outputs: Declined or conditioned cases, escalation record, premium refund instructions

steps.name: Record Supervisory Review & Suitability Audit Trail
steps.description: Record the insurer's supervisory review evidencing the supervision system NAIC Model #275 requires, retain suitability documentation per record-retention rules, and feed case outcomes into producer monitoring and market-conduct reporting.
steps.supporting: Annuity Suitability Analyst, Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager
steps.inputs: Suitability determinations, supervisory review checklist, record-retention schedule
steps.outputs: Supervisory sign-off record, suitability audit trail, producer monitoring data

steps.name: Validate Exchange & Transfer Paperwork
steps.description: Validate 1035 exchange forms, trustee-to-trustee transfer and rollover authorizations for completeness, confirm IRC Section 1035 like-kind eligibility or qualified-money transfer typing, and verify ceding carrier contract details and registration match the new application.
steps.supporting: New Business Case Manager, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: 1035 exchange form, transfer or rollover authorization, ceding carrier contract details, cost basis statement, qualified money type indicators
steps.outputs: Validated exchange request, eligibility and money-type confirmation, registration match verification

steps.name: Confirm Replacement Compliance Before Funds Request
steps.description: Before requesting funds, confirm the replacement notices, best-interest determination and surrender-charge impact analysis are complete for the exchange per NAIC Models #613 and #275, and hold any funds request where the suitability case is unresolved.
steps.inputs: Replacement notices, best-interest suitability determination, existing contract surrender-charge impact analysis
steps.outputs: Cleared-to-request confirmation, held cases with unresolved suitability, compliance documentation

steps.name: Initiate Funds Request to Ceding Carrier
steps.description: Transmit the exchange or transfer request directly to the ceding carrier or custodian so funds move carrier-to-carrier without owner receipt (preserving tax deferral), and record the expected funds amount and target date.
steps.inputs: Cleared exchange request, ceding carrier transmission requirements, signature guarantees where required
steps.outputs: Transmitted transfer request, expected funds record, carrier acknowledgment

steps.name: Track Incoming Funds & Follow Up Aging Transfers
steps.description: Monitor pending transfers against expected dates, follow up with ceding carriers on aging requests, alert the producer and applicant to delays, and flag cases approaching rate-lock expiry for re-quote or extension decisions.
steps.inputs: Expected funds records, ceding carrier status responses, rate-lock expiry dates
steps.outputs: Transfer status updates, aging follow-up actions, rate-lock expiry alerts

steps.name: Apply Received Funds & Record Carryover Cost Basis
steps.description: Apply received exchange and transfer funds to the contract, record the carryover cost basis reported by the ceding carrier for future tax reporting, reconcile received versus expected amounts, and confirm funding completion to the owner and producer.
steps.supporting: Tax Analyst, Policy Data Entry Clerk
steps.inputs: Received funds, ceding carrier cost basis statement, expected funds record, premium application rules
steps.outputs: Applied premium, recorded carryover cost basis, funding reconciliation, funding confirmation notices

steps.name: Generate Contract & Issue Package
steps.description: Assemble the approved good-order application, suitability sign-off and applied premium, generate the annuity contract with data pages, riders and state-required disclosures, and set the contract effective date and credited rates per the rate lock.
steps.supporting: Policy Data Entry Clerk, New Business Case Manager
steps.inputs: Approved good-order application, suitability sign-off, applied premium and rate-lock terms, product contract forms and riders
steps.outputs: Issued annuity contract, contract data pages, state-required disclosure package

steps.name: Deliver Contract & Capture Delivery Receipt
steps.description: Deliver the contract to the owner via producer, mail or e-delivery, capture the signed delivery receipt or e-signature acknowledgment, and record the delivery date that starts the state-mandated free-look period (typically 10-30 days).
steps.inputs: Issued contract package, delivery method election, state free-look period rules
steps.outputs: Delivery receipt or e-signature acknowledgment, free-look start date, delivery exception follow-ups

steps.name: Confirm Issue & Trigger Producer Compensation
steps.description: Send issue confirmation to the owner and producer, release the case to in-force status, and trigger the commission feed with chargeback terms tied to the free-look and early-surrender windows.
steps.inputs: Issued contract record, delivery confirmation, commission schedule and chargeback terms
steps.outputs: Issue confirmation statements, commission feed trigger, chargeback terms record

steps.name: Monitor Free-Look Period & Process Cancellations
steps.description: Track contracts inside the free-look window, process timely cancellation requests with full premium refund (or account value where state rules require for variable products), reverse the contract record, and issue commission chargeback notices.
steps.inputs: Free-look cancellation requests, free-look start and end dates, refund calculation rules
steps.outputs: Free-look refunds, contract reversal entries, commission chargeback notices

steps.name: Finalize In-Force Records & Owner Onboarding
steps.description: Confirm the contract record is complete in the policy administration system after free-look expiry, register the owner for self-service and statement delivery preferences, and hand the contract to ongoing servicing.
steps.supporting: Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist, Customer Service Rep
steps.inputs: In-force contract record, owner contact and delivery preferences, self-service registration data
steps.outputs: Finalized in-force record, portal registration, servicing handoff confirmation

steps.name: Receive & Validate In-Force Service Request
steps.description: Accept annuity in-force service requests (allocation change, beneficiary or ownership change, banking or address update, systematic program election), verify owner identity and signing authority, confirm forms are in good order, and log the transaction case in the policy administration system.
steps.supporting: Life Policy Service Representative, Customer Service Rep
steps.inputs: Service request forms, contract record, identity and signing authority verification
steps.outputs: Good-order service request, verified owner authority, logged transaction case

steps.name: Process Fund Allocation Changes & Rebalancing
steps.description: Execute subaccount and fixed-account allocation changes, transfers and automatic rebalancing instructions, enforcing fund availability, transfer-frequency and market-timing restrictions and same-day market-close cutoffs for variable contracts.
steps.inputs: Allocation instruction, fund availability and transfer-restriction rules, market-close cutoff times, current allocation record
steps.outputs: Updated fund allocations, executed trade instructions, allocation confirmation notice

steps.name: Process Beneficiary & Ownership Changes
steps.description: Record beneficiary designation changes, ownership transfers and assignments, validate spousal consent and community-property requirements where applicable, screen added parties against sanctions watchlists in line with the enterprise financial-crime program, and assess tax implications of ownership transfers.
steps.inputs: Beneficiary and ownership change forms, spousal consent where required, sanctions screening lists, tax implication guidelines
steps.outputs: Updated beneficiary designation, recorded ownership change or assignment, screening clearance, change confirmations

steps.name: Maintain Banking, Address & Systematic Program Instructions
steps.description: Update banking details with pre-note validation, maintain address and contact records with returned-mail handling, and set up or amend systematic withdrawal, dollar-cost-averaging and interest-sweep program schedules.
steps.inputs: Banking change forms, address update requests, systematic program elections, pre-note validation results
steps.outputs: Updated payment instructions, maintained contact records, systematic program schedules

steps.name: Issue Confirmations & Update Contract Statements
steps.description: Generate transaction confirmations for each completed service request, post updates to quarterly and annual statement data, and monitor servicing quality and turnaround against service-level targets.
steps.inputs: Completed transaction records, statement data feeds, service-level targets
steps.outputs: Transaction confirmations, updated statement data, servicing quality metrics

steps.name: Intake & Validate Withdrawal Request
steps.description: Receive partial withdrawal and systematic withdrawal requests, verify owner authority and good order, confirm the request against free-withdrawal corridor provisions and minimum-balance rules, and flag pre-59½ IRS penalty exposure for owner disclosure.
steps.inputs: Withdrawal request form, free-withdrawal corridor rules, contract values, minimum-balance requirements
steps.outputs: Validated withdrawal request, charge and penalty applicability flags, owner disclosure notices

steps.name: Calculate Withdrawal Amount, Charges & MVA
steps.description: Calculate the gross and net withdrawal amounts applying surrender charges beyond the free corridor, market value adjustments, and rider-benefit reductions, and estimate the taxable gain-first (LIFO) portion for non-qualified contracts.
steps.inputs: Validated withdrawal request, surrender charge schedule, market value adjustment factors, cost basis and gain records, rider benefit values
steps.outputs: Net withdrawal calculation, surrender charge and MVA detail, rider benefit reduction record, taxable amount estimate

steps.name: Calculate & Monitor Required Minimum Distributions
steps.description: Calculate annual RMDs for qualified annuity contracts from prior year-end fair market value plus the actuarial present value of riders using IRS life-expectancy tables and the SECURE 2.0 applicable age, issue owner RMD notices, and track satisfaction to avoid excise-tax exposure.
steps.inputs: Prior year-end fair market value, actuarial present value of rider benefits, IRS life-expectancy tables, owner birth date and applicable RMD age
steps.outputs: RMD calculations, owner RMD notices, missed-RMD follow-up list

steps.name: Screen Payee Against Sanctions Watchlists
steps.description: Screen the payee, owner and any changed beneficiaries against OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists before funds release; on a true match, block the transaction, report to OFAC within 10 business days, and route blocked funds per OFAC requirements, following the enterprise financial-crime program.
steps.inputs: Payee and owner identity data, beneficiary details, OFAC SDN and consolidated screening lists
steps.outputs: Screening result, cleared payee or blocked-transaction escalation, OFAC report where required

steps.name: Disburse Funds & Apply Tax Withholding
steps.description: Apply the owner's federal and state withholding elections (W-4P/W-4R) or default rates, release net funds to the cleared payee, update contract values and rider benefits in the system of record, and generate the distribution record that feeds 1099-R reporting.
steps.inputs: Cleared withdrawal transaction, net withdrawal calculation, withholding elections, payee banking details
steps.outputs: Disbursed funds, applied withholding, updated contract values, 1099-R distribution feed

steps.name: Receive Surrender Request & Verify Authority
steps.description: Receive the full surrender request, verify owner identity, signing authority and any assignee or irrevocable-beneficiary consents, confirm forms are in good order, and log the surrender case.
steps.inputs: Surrender request form, contract record, identity and authority verification, assignee or beneficiary consents
steps.outputs: Good-order surrender request, verified owner authority, logged surrender case

steps.name: Perform Conservation Outreach & Replacement Review
steps.description: Disclose surrender charges, MVA and forfeited rider benefits to the owner, attempt conservation where appropriate, and where the surrender funds an external replacement or outgoing 1035 exchange, verify replacement notices and best-interest documentation per NAIC Models #613 and #275 before release.
steps.inputs: Surrender charge and lost-benefit disclosure, replacement disclosure forms, incoming carrier exchange paperwork
steps.outputs: Conservation outcome, replacement compliance confirmation, documented owner acknowledgment

steps.name: Calculate Surrender Value, Charges & MVA
steps.description: Calculate the gross account value, apply the contractual surrender charge schedule, market value adjustment and accrued rider charges, determine the net cash surrender value, and produce the calculation statement for the owner file.
steps.inputs: Account value, surrender charge schedule, market value adjustment factors, accrued rider charges, premium tax rules where applicable
steps.outputs: Gross and net surrender value, surrender charge and MVA detail, calculation audit record

steps.name: Screen Payee & Approve Large Disbursements
steps.description: Screen the surrender payee against sanctions watchlists per the enterprise financial-crime program, apply fraud and elder-financial-exploitation checks, and obtain dual authorization for disbursements above approval thresholds.
steps.supporting: Financial Crime AML Officer, Policy Admin Ops Lead
steps.inputs: Payee identity data, sanctions screening lists, fraud and exploitation indicators, disbursement approval thresholds
steps.outputs: Cleared payee, large-disbursement approval, escalated suspicious cases

steps.name: Disburse Surrender Proceeds & Terminate Contract
steps.description: Apply withholding elections, disburse net surrender proceeds to the cleared payee or successor carrier, terminate the contract status in the system of record, issue commission chargeback notices where applicable, and feed the distribution to 1099-R reporting.
steps.inputs: Net surrender value, withholding elections, cleared payee or carrier instructions, commission chargeback terms
steps.outputs: Disbursed surrender proceeds, terminated contract status, commission chargeback notices, 1099-R distribution feed

steps.name: Present Payout Options & Quote Annuity Income
steps.description: Generate income quotes across available payout options (life only, joint and survivor, life with period certain, fixed period) using current annuity purchase rates and contractual guaranteed factors, and deliver the election kit with required disclosures to the owner.
steps.inputs: Contract accumulation value, annuity purchase rates, guaranteed payout option factors, owner and annuitant data
steps.outputs: Payout option quotes, payout election kit, disclosure documents

steps.name: Capture & Validate Payout Election
steps.description: Receive the signed payout election, verify annuitant proof of age and identity, obtain spousal consent for qualified contracts where required, confirm the election is irrevocable-understanding acknowledged, and record the validated election.
steps.supporting: Life Policy Service Representative, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Signed payout election form, proof of age and identity, spousal consent where required, beneficiary designations for certain periods
steps.outputs: Validated payout election, verified annuitant data, recorded election acknowledgment

steps.name: Calculate Income Payments & Exclusion Ratio
steps.description: Calculate the periodic income payment from the annuitized value and elected option, determine the exclusion ratio splitting each non-qualified payment between tax-free return of basis and taxable earnings under the IRC Section 72 General Rule (IRS Publication 939; the Pub 575 Simplified Method applies to qualified-plan payouts), and set the payment start date and mode.
steps.inputs: Annuitized contract value, elected payout option and factors, cost basis record, IRS expected-return tables
steps.outputs: Scheduled payment amount, exclusion ratio determination, payment start date and mode

steps.name: Establish Payout Records & Release First Payment
steps.description: Convert the contract to annuitized payout status, establish the payment schedule and payee banking instructions, apply withholding elections, and release and confirm the first income payment.
steps.supporting: Payment Processing Clerk, Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist
steps.inputs: Validated election, payment calculation, payee banking instructions, withholding elections
steps.outputs: Annuitized contract status, established payment schedule, first income payment confirmation

steps.name: Administer Ongoing Payments & Proof of Life
steps.description: Run recurring income payments, perform periodic existence verification on life-contingent payouts, suspend payments on failed verification or returned funds pending investigation, and process payee changes and survivor continuations on annuitant death.
steps.inputs: Payment schedule, existence verification responses, returned payment alerts, survivor continuation elections
steps.outputs: Recurring income payments, existence verification results, suspended-payment cases, survivor continuation records

steps.name: Capture & Maintain Withholding Elections
steps.description: Capture federal Form W-4P/W-4R and state withholding elections at distribution setup, apply mandatory and default withholding rates where no valid election exists (including 20% mandatory withholding on eligible rollover distributions), and maintain an election change log.
steps.inputs: Form W-4P and W-4R elections, state withholding rules, mandatory and default withholding rates
steps.outputs: Applied withholding elections, default-rate applications, election change log

steps.name: Remit Withheld Taxes & Reconcile Deposits
steps.description: Aggregate withheld federal and state taxes across annuity distributions, remit deposits on the required schedule, and reconcile remittances to distribution records and the general ledger.
steps.inputs: Withholding totals by jurisdiction, deposit schedules, distribution records
steps.outputs: Federal and state tax remittances, deposit reconciliation, ledger postings

steps.name: Produce & File 1099-R Forms
steps.description: Compile annual distribution records with taxable amount determinations and IRS distribution codes, generate Form 1099-R for each recipient with reportable distributions, transmit to the IRS electronically, and mail or e-deliver recipient copies by the statutory deadline.
steps.inputs: Annual distribution records, taxable amount determinations, withholding totals, IRS distribution code matrix
steps.outputs: Filed 1099-R forms, IRS electronic transmission confirmation, delivered recipient copies

steps.name: Process Corrections & Resolve Tax Inquiries
steps.description: Issue corrected 1099-R forms for reporting errors, respond to owner and IRS inquiries on taxable amounts, distribution codes and withholding, and feed recurring error causes back into distribution-processing controls.
steps.supporting: Customer Service Rep, Annuity Service Specialist
steps.inputs: Correction requests, owner and IRS inquiries, original 1099-R records
steps.outputs: Corrected 1099-R forms, resolved tax inquiries, control improvement feedback

notes: Structure: 3 L3s / 9 L4s / 44 L5 steps covering the full scope guidance — application & good order, NAIC #275 best-interest suitability, 1035 exchanges/transfers, issue & free-look, allocation changes & account maintenance, withdrawals & RMDs, surrender & charge calculation, annuitization & payout election, and withholding/1099-R. All L3/L4 names are annuity-specific; no P&C process-area name from vs-outline.json is reused.

Relocated steps absorbed (from life-relocations.json): CI-06-05-S02 'Review Replacement & Suitability' became 'Review Replacement Activity & Disclosures' in the Suitability & Best-Interest Review L4; CI-04-05-S01 'Receive & Validate In-Force Transaction Request' became 'Receive & Validate In-Force Service Request' (adapted to annuity transactions, lead moved to Annuity Service Specialist); CI-04-05-S02 was split into 'Confirm Replacement Compliance Before Funds Request' (1035 Exchange L4) and 'Perform Conservation Outreach & Replacement Review' (Surrender L4); CI-04-05-S03 'Screen Payee Against Sanctions Watchlists' kept nearly verbatim in the Withdrawals L4 (with a lighter screen-and-approve step in the Surrender L4); CI-04-05-S04 'Disburse Funds & Apply Tax Withholding' kept in the Withdrawals L4 with lead adapted to Annuity Service Specialist.

Relocated steps NOT absorbed here (they belong to the life-side streams, not annuities): CI-02-01-S07 (death certificate/beneficiary validation — life & annuity death claims) and CI-06-05-S01 (medical/financial evidence underwriting — annuities are generally not medically underwritten) should land in the Life claims/underwriting streams; CI-04-05-S05 (DMF matching & escheatment) should land in the Life policy servicing stream — its escheatment remittance leg already exists as Finance F-11-05 ('Escheatment and unclaimed property reporting'), so this stream only references DMF/escheatment rather than duplicating it (annuitant existence checks in 'Administer Ongoing Payments & Proof of Life' are the in-flow payout control, not the enterprise DMF sweep).

Shared-stream references (checked against vs-outline.json, not duplicated): the sanctions/AML program is owned by Risk & Compliance RC-20-05 — the two in-flow payee screening steps here are retained because OFAC requires screening at point of funds release inside the disbursement flow (consistent with other streams that carry in-flow screening); escheatment/unclaimed property = Finance F-11-05; formal complaint handling = Customer Service OC-14-03 (servicing complaints route there, no complaint L4 added here); recurring premium billing/cash application = Billing CI-01 (only the new-business initial premium/rate-lock step is in-flow here); commission payment processing lives with distribution — this stream only triggers feeds and chargebacks.

Regulatory grounding from web research: NAIC Model #275 (2020 best-interest revisions — care/disclosure/conflict-of-interest/documentation obligations, insurer supervision system, producer product-specific training; adoption verified at 49 jurisdictions via NAIC/industry trackers; NY applies its own Reg 187), NAIC Model #613 replacement notices, NAIC Model #245 disclosure/buyer's guide, IRC Section 1035 direct carrier-to-carrier exchange rules, state free-look periods (10-30 days), IRC Section 72 General Rule (IRS Pub 939) exclusion-ratio annuitization taxation and LIFO gain-first withdrawal taxation, SECURE 2.0 RMD applicable age with rider actuarial-present-value inclusion, Form W-4P/W-4R withholding and 20% mandatory rollover withholding, Form 1099-R production/filing/correction per IRS instructions.

Roles: all leads/supporting are verbatim from role-inventory.json, weighted to the Life & Retirement set (Annuity Service Specialist, Annuity Suitability Analyst, New Business Case Manager, Policy Issue Specialist, Life Policy Service Representative, Retirement Operations Administrator, Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist, Billing Operations Manager) with leads as day-to-day doers; deliverable systems of record are verbatim from app-inventory.json (Policy Administration Platform, Document & Forms Management, Payment Gateway, Finance ERP / General Ledger).

REVIEW CHANGE — L3 renames for the life-only rule: 'Contract Issue & In-Force Account Servicing' → 'Annuity Contract Issue & In-Force Servicing' and 'Surrender, Annuitization & Payout Administration' → 'Annuity Surrender, Annuitization & Payout Administration' so every L3 carries the annuity line of business explicitly (the first L3 already did).

REVIEW CHANGE — tax citation fixed after web check: the exclusion ratio for non-qualified annuitized payouts is computed under the IRC Section 72 General Rule per IRS Publication 939, not Publication 575 (Pub 575's Simplified Method covers qualified-plan payouts). Corrected in the 'Calculate Income Payments & Exclusion Ratio' step description and in the regulatory-grounding note. Sources: irs.gov/publications/p939, irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-publication-939.

REVIEW CHANGE — AML at new business: added a source-of-funds red-flag referral clause (cash-equivalent/third-party funding) to 'Confirm Initial Premium Receipt & Rate Lock', since annuities are covered products under FinCEN's insurer AML rule (31 CFR 1025); the AML program itself remains owned by Risk & Compliance RC-20-05 — no new step added, reference only.
REVIEW CHANGE — note correction: step count was stated as 43 but the design contains 44 L5 steps (15+15+14); fixed.

REVIEW VERIFICATION (no fix needed): all 21 distinct lead/supporting role names matched role-inventory.json verbatim and all 4 sorApplication values matched app-inventory.json verbatim (checked programmatically). Duplication scan of all 44 step names against vs-outline.json found exact collisions only with Policy Administration & Servicing CI-04-05 ('Screen Payee Against Sanctions Watchlists', 'Disburse Funds & Apply Tax Withholding', near-match 'Receive & Validate In-Force Transaction Request') — these are precisely the relocation-source steps this stream is mandated to absorb; vs-outline.json still shows the stale pre-relocation placement. The RC-20-05 near-match 'Screen Parties Against Sanctions & Watchlists' is the enterprise program step; the in-flow screening here is the point-of-disbursement control the scope guidance explicitly permits. NAIC #275 adoption count (49 jurisdictions) verified via content.naic.org and aipma.com trackers.

REVIEW VERIFICATION (no fix needed): flow order checked against industry practice — suitability/best-interest sign-off precedes contract issue (issue step consumes the suitability sign-off as input); replacement compliance is confirmed before 1035 funds requests; sanctions screening precedes every disbursement; withholding elections precede funds release; RMD monitoring sits with qualified-contract withdrawals; proof-of-life existence checks gate life-contingent payouts; free-look starts at delivery receipt with commission chargebacks on cancellation. 'Verify Producer License, Appointment & Product Training' is the in-flow point-of-sale check only — producer licensing/appointment as a process stays with Distribution & Channel Management (PG-16-02).

steps.name: Gather Plan Documents & Service Requirements
steps.description: Collect the executed recordkeeping service agreement, plan document, adoption agreement and trust/custody arrangements from the plan sponsor; confirm plan provisions (eligibility, vesting, match formula, loan and hardship features) and the prior recordkeeper deconversion timeline.
steps.inputs: Executed service agreement, plan document and adoption agreement, trust and custody agreements, prior recordkeeper deconversion schedule
steps.outputs: Plan provision summary, onboarding requirements checklist, conversion project timeline

steps.name: Configure Plan Rules on Recordkeeping Platform
steps.description: Set up the plan on the recordkeeping system of record: eligibility and entry dates, contribution sources and match formula, vesting schedules, investment lineup and QDIA default, loan and withdrawal parameters, and payroll file specifications.
steps.supporting: Business Systems Analyst, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Plan provision summary, investment lineup and QDIA designation, payroll vendor file specifications
steps.outputs: Configured plan rules, payroll file mapping, test transaction results

steps.name: Distribute Blackout Notice & Coordinate Conversion Window
steps.description: Prepare and deliver the ERISA 101(i) blackout notice to participants 30-60 days before the conversion blackout begins, coordinate the liquidation and asset-transfer dates with the prior recordkeeper and custodian, and freeze transactions for the blackout window.
steps.inputs: Conversion project timeline, participant address and e-delivery data, blackout window dates
steps.outputs: Delivered blackout notices, confirmed asset-transfer schedule, transaction freeze confirmation

steps.name: Receive & Reconcile Conversion Records and Assets
steps.description: Load participant-level conversion records (balances by source, vesting service, beneficiaries, outstanding loans) from the prior recordkeeper, receive transferred assets from the custodian, and reconcile share/unit and cash totals to the deconversion statement to the penny.
steps.supporting: Cash Application Specialist, Data Quality Manager
steps.inputs: Prior recordkeeper deconversion files, asset transfer wire confirmations, custodian statements
steps.outputs: Loaded participant records, reconciled conversion balances, exception and break list
steps.deliverable: Conversion reconciliation and go-live acceptance package

steps.name: Validate Go-Live & Lift Blackout
steps.description: Run go-live validation (balance spot checks, loan amortization continuity, web and statement display), obtain plan sponsor acceptance, lift the blackout, and notify participants that account access and transactions are restored.
steps.supporting: Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist, Quality Assurance Analyst (Service)
steps.inputs: Reconciled conversion balances, validation test scripts, sponsor acceptance sign-off
steps.outputs: Go-live acceptance, blackout-lift confirmation, participant access restoration notice

steps.name: Process Eligibility & Enrollment Files
steps.description: Ingest sponsor census and payroll feeds to determine newly eligible employees, apply plan entry dates and automatic-enrollment provisions (including SECURE 2.0 mandatory auto-enrollment for covered new plans), and trigger enrollment kits and required notices.
steps.supporting: Data Quality Manager, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Sponsor census file, payroll feed, plan eligibility and auto-enrollment rules
steps.outputs: Eligibility determinations, enrollment triggers, auto-enrollment notice queue

steps.name: Establish Participant Accounts & Investment Elections
steps.description: Open participant accounts, capture deferral elections and investment allocations, default non-electing auto-enrolled participants into the QDIA, and confirm elections back to the participant.
steps.supporting: Customer Service Rep, Contact Center Agent
steps.inputs: Eligibility determinations, participant deferral and investment elections, QDIA designation
steps.outputs: Established participant accounts, recorded elections, election confirmations
steps.deliverable: Established participant account record with deferral and investment elections

steps.name: Maintain Indicative Data, Beneficiaries & Vesting
steps.description: Process ongoing updates to participant indicative data, beneficiary designations (with spousal-consent validation where required), vesting service credit and rehire bridging, keeping the participant-level audit trail ERISA-compliant.
steps.inputs: Participant change requests, beneficiary designation forms, sponsor service-hours data
steps.outputs: Updated participant records, validated beneficiary designations, recalculated vesting percentages

steps.name: Reconcile Payroll Data Discrepancies with Sponsors
steps.description: Identify and resolve mismatches between payroll feeds and recordkeeping data (missing deferral changes, compensation errors, ineligible contributions), returning corrected files to sponsors and documenting recurring data-quality issues.
steps.supporting: Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist, Billing Operations Manager
steps.inputs: Payroll exception reports, sponsor payroll files, plan compensation definitions
steps.outputs: Resolved data discrepancies, corrected payroll mappings, sponsor data-quality log

steps.name: Generate & Distribute Participant Benefit Statements
steps.description: Produce quarterly participant benefit statements showing balances, vesting, activity and the quarterly fee/expense amounts required under 404(a)(5), delivering via the DOL electronic-delivery safe harbor or paper as elected.
steps.inputs: Period-end account balances, transaction activity, fee and expense data, delivery preferences
steps.outputs: Quarterly benefit statements, delivery confirmations, returned-mail exceptions

steps.name: Resolve Escalated Participant Account Cases
steps.description: Work participant service cases escalated from the enterprise contact center (first-line intake and complaint handling live in Customer Service OC-14): account research, transaction tracing, correction requests and sponsor-initiated inquiries.
steps.supporting: Contact Center Agent, Customer Service Rep
steps.inputs: Escalated service cases, participant account history, plan provision rules
steps.outputs: Resolved service cases, account corrections, case documentation

steps.name: Process Investment Exchanges & Deferral Rate Changes
steps.description: Execute participant-directed fund exchanges, rebalances and deferral-rate changes received via web, phone or form; enforce frequent-trading and equity-wash restrictions; and confirm completed transactions to the participant.
steps.supporting: Annuity Service Specialist, Customer Service Rep
steps.inputs: Participant transaction requests, fund trading restrictions, current account allocations
steps.outputs: Executed exchanges and rebalances, updated deferral rates, transaction confirmations

steps.name: Qualify & Administer Domestic Relations Orders
steps.description: Review received domestic relations orders against the plan's QDRO procedures, segregate the disputed amount during the determination period per ERISA 206(d)(3), issue the written qualification or rejection determination, and establish the alternate payee account on qualification.
steps.inputs: Domestic relations order, plan QDRO procedures, participant account balances
steps.outputs: Qualification determination, segregated account hold, alternate payee account

steps.name: Process Plan Death Benefit Claims
steps.description: On notice of a participant's death, validate the certified death certificate and beneficiary entitlement (consistent with the death-claim validation pattern homed in Claims Intake-to-Settlement), apply spousal-beneficiary rules and the SECURE Act 10-year payout framework, and establish beneficiary accounts or payouts.
steps.inputs: Certified death certificate, beneficiary designation on file, claimant identification, plan distribution rules
steps.outputs: Verified beneficiary entitlement, beneficiary account or payout instruction, claim documentation

steps.name: Locate Missing Participants & Resolve Stale Payments
steps.description: Run DOL missing-participant search steps (address traces, certified mail, beneficiary outreach) for unresponsive terminated participants and uncashed distribution checks; hand unresolvable dormant amounts to the enterprise escheatment process (Finance F-11-05) for state remittance.
steps.inputs: Returned-mail and uncashed-check lists, address trace results, DOL missing-participant guidance
steps.outputs: Located participant updates, documented search evidence, escheatment hand-off file

steps.name: Receive & Validate Payroll Contribution Files
steps.description: Ingest each payroll-cycle contribution file, validate participant matches, source coding (pre-tax, Roth, match, loan repayment) and compensation reasonableness, and return rejected records to the sponsor for correction.
steps.supporting: Data Quality Manager, Billing Operations Manager
steps.inputs: Sponsor payroll contribution file, participant records, source and limit edit rules
steps.outputs: Validated contribution file, rejected-record report, expected funding amount

steps.name: Collect & Reconcile Contribution Funding
steps.description: Receive ACH/wire funding from the sponsor, match cash received to the validated contribution file, and clear funding shortfalls or overages before allocation; retirement-specific because deferral cash becomes an ERISA plan asset on segregation (general cash application lives in Billing CI-01-02).
steps.inputs: ACH and wire receipts, validated contribution file, plan trust account details
steps.outputs: Matched funding, funding exception list, cleared-to-allocate confirmation

steps.name: Monitor Deposit Timeliness & Flag Late Remittances
steps.description: Track each remittance against 29 CFR 2510.3-102 timing — the 7-business-day safe harbor for small plans and earliest-reasonable-segregation standard otherwise — flag late deposits, calculate lost earnings, and support sponsor VFCP corrections and Form 5500 late-deposit reporting.
steps.supporting: Retirement Operations Administrator, Billing Operations Manager
steps.inputs: Payroll withholding dates, funding receipt dates, deposit timeliness rules
steps.outputs: Deposit timeliness log, late-remittance flags, lost-earnings calculations

steps.name: Allocate Contributions to Participant Accounts
steps.description: Post validated, funded contributions to participant accounts by source and invest per each participant's elections (or QDIA default), maintaining penny-level traceability from payroll withholding to invested units.
steps.inputs: Cleared-to-allocate confirmation, participant investment elections, fund prices
steps.outputs: Posted participant allocations, generated purchase trades, allocation audit trail

steps.name: Apply Employer Match & True-Up Calculations
steps.description: Calculate per-payroll employer match using the plan formula, run annual true-up calculations where the plan provides them, and post employer-source allocations with vesting attached.
steps.inputs: Plan match formula, participant deferrals and compensation, plan-year contribution totals
steps.outputs: Calculated match amounts, true-up allocations, employer-source postings

steps.name: Resolve Suspense & Allocation Exceptions
steps.description: Work the contribution suspense account daily: research unallocated amounts, ineligible contributions and orphaned funding, apply EPCRS-aligned corrections (refunds or reallocation with earnings), and age-report unresolved items to the sponsor.
steps.inputs: Suspense account balances, exception research notes, correction method rules
steps.outputs: Cleared suspense items, corrective reallocations or refunds, aged exception report

l4s.name: Omnibus trade settlement and trust reconciliation

steps.name: Generate & Transmit Daily Omnibus Trade Files
steps.description: Aggregate all participant-level purchase, redemption and exchange activity into daily omnibus trade instructions per fund, and transmit to fund companies and the custodian via NSCC Fund/SERV by the trading cutoff.
steps.inputs: Daily participant transaction activity, fund trading cutoffs, omnibus account registrations
steps.outputs: Transmitted omnibus trade files, trade acknowledgments, cutoff exception list

steps.name: Settle Trades & Post Daily Valuations
steps.description: Confirm trade settlement, receive end-of-day NAVs and dividend/capital-gain distributions, and post prices and accruals so every participant account is valued daily.
steps.inputs: Trade confirmations, end-of-day fund prices, dividend and distribution notices
steps.outputs: Settled trades, posted daily valuations, accrued income allocations

steps.name: Reconcile Units & Cash to Custodian and Fund Records
steps.description: Reconcile recordkeeping share/unit positions and cash to custodian trust statements and fund-company omnibus positions daily, investigating and clearing breaks within service-level timeframes.
steps.supporting: Investment Operations Manager, Cash Application Specialist
steps.inputs: Recordkeeping position file, custodian trust statements, fund omnibus position reports
steps.outputs: Completed reconciliations, break investigation log, cleared discrepancies

steps.name: Correct Trade & Pricing Errors with Make-Whole Adjustments
steps.description: Identify trade, pricing and as-of processing errors, calculate participant make-whole adjustments so no participant is harmed, book gains/losses to the error account, and document root cause for control reporting.
steps.inputs: Error and break investigation log, historical prices, as-of processing rules
steps.outputs: Corrected transactions, make-whole adjustments, error root-cause documentation

steps.name: Maintain Investment Lineup & Execute Fund Changes
steps.description: Implement sponsor-directed investment lineup changes: set up new funds, run mapping strategies for removed funds, issue advance participant change notices, and update 404(a)(5) comparative disclosures to match the new lineup.
steps.inputs: Sponsor fund-change directions, fund setup data, mapping strategy, participant notice requirements
steps.outputs: Updated investment lineup, executed mapping trades, delivered fund-change notices

steps.name: Receive Distribution Request & Verify Eligibility
steps.description: Validate the participant's distributable event (termination, retirement, disability, in-service age 59½), confirm vested balance and outstanding loan offsets, and obtain spousal consent where the plan's annuity or J&S provisions require it.
steps.supporting: Customer Service Rep, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Distribution request form, employment termination data, vested balance, spousal consent where required
steps.outputs: Verified distribution eligibility, vested amount determination, good-order request

steps.name: Deliver 402(f) Special Tax Notice & Capture Elections
steps.description: Provide the IRC 402(f) special tax notice within the 30-180 day window, capture the participant's payment election (lump sum, direct rollover, installments) and federal/state withholding elections, and document notice delivery.
steps.inputs: Good-order request, 402(f) notice content, participant election forms
steps.outputs: Delivered tax notice, captured payment and withholding elections, election documentation

steps.name: Document Rollover Best-Interest Review
steps.description: Where a rollover into a Meridian IRA or annuity is recommended, complete and retain the DOL PTE 2020-02 best-interest documentation (specific reasons the rollover benefits the participant, fee comparison, conflict mitigation) before processing; in-flow by regulation, though the firmwide suitability framework parallels Policy Administration CI-04-05.
steps.inputs: Rollover recommendation record, plan and IRA fee comparison, participant profile
steps.outputs: Best-interest determination, documented basis of recommendation, escalated unsuitable cases

steps.name: Screen Distribution Payees Against Sanctions Lists
steps.description: Screen the payee and any alternate payee against OFAC SDN and consolidated lists before funds release, blocking and escalating true matches; in-flow step required by OFAC pre-disbursement obligations — the enterprise sanctions/AML program itself is owned in Risk & Compliance RC-20-05.
steps.inputs: Payee identity data, banking instructions, OFAC SDN and consolidated screening lists
steps.outputs: Screening result, cleared payee or blocked-transaction escalation

steps.name: Calculate Withholding & Disburse Funds
steps.description: Liquidate the required units, apply 20% mandatory federal withholding to eligible rollover distributions paid in cash (and elected withholding otherwise), disburse via direct rollover, ACH or check, update the account, and generate the 1099-R tax record.
steps.inputs: Cleared payee, payment and withholding elections, liquidation proceeds
steps.outputs: Disbursed funds, withholding remittance, updated account, 1099-R record

steps.name: Process Force-Out Cash-Outs & Automatic Rollovers
steps.description: Identify terminated participants with vested balances under the plan's cash-out threshold (up to $7,000 under SECURE 2.0), deliver required notices, cash out balances of $1,000 or less, and roll balances between $1,000 and the threshold to an automatic-rollover safe-harbor IRA.
steps.inputs: Terminated participant balance report, cash-out threshold rules, safe-harbor IRA provider agreement
steps.outputs: Force-out notices, processed cash-outs, automatic rollover IRA transfers

l4s.name: Plan loan and hardship withdrawal administration

steps.name: Validate Loan Eligibility & Limits
steps.description: Verify the participant's loan request against plan loan policy and IRC 72(p) limits — the lesser of $50,000 (reduced by the highest outstanding balance in the prior 12 months) or 50% of the vested balance — and confirm the number of outstanding loans allowed.
steps.inputs: Loan request, vested account balance, prior 12-month loan history, plan loan policy
steps.outputs: Loan eligibility determination, maximum available loan amount, approved loan terms

steps.name: Originate Loan & Establish Amortization Schedule
steps.description: Execute the loan agreement and promissory note, set the level-amortization repayment schedule (max 5 years, longer for principal residence) at the plan's interest rate, disburse proceeds, and transmit the payroll deduction instruction to the sponsor.
steps.supporting: Payment Processing Clerk, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Approved loan terms, promissory note and loan agreement, payroll deduction setup
steps.outputs: Disbursed loan proceeds, established amortization schedule, payroll deduction instruction
steps.deliverable: Executed loan agreement with amortization schedule

steps.name: Monitor Repayments, Cure Periods & Defaults
steps.description: Apply payroll loan repayments to principal and interest, chase missed payments through the IRC 72(p) cure period (end of the calendar quarter following the missed quarter), and process deemed distributions with 1099-R reporting on default or loan offsets at termination.
steps.inputs: Loan repayment feeds, amortization schedules, cure-period rules
steps.outputs: Posted repayments, delinquency notices, deemed-distribution and loan-offset records

steps.name: Review Hardship Withdrawal Requests Against Safe-Harbor Criteria
steps.description: Evaluate hardship requests against the IRS safe-harbor immediate-and-heavy-need events (medical, home purchase/eviction, tuition, funeral, casualty, disaster), apply SECURE 2.0 participant self-certification where the plan allows, and limit the amount to the documented need plus taxes.
steps.inputs: Hardship request and certification, safe-harbor event criteria, available hardship sources
steps.outputs: Hardship approval or denial, approved withdrawal amount, certification documentation

steps.name: Disburse Hardship Funds & Apply Tax Reporting
steps.description: Liquidate approved hardship amounts from permitted sources, apply elected withholding (hardships are not eligible rollover distributions), disburse to the participant, and generate the 1099-R with the appropriate distribution code.
steps.inputs: Approved hardship amount, withholding election, payee banking details
steps.outputs: Disbursed hardship funds, updated account balances, 1099-R record

steps.name: Identify RMD-Eligible Participants & Beneficiaries
steps.description: Build the annual RMD population: participants reaching the SECURE 2.0 applicable age (73), terminated participants past their required beginning date, application of the still-working exception for non-5% owners, and beneficiary accounts under the 10-year and eligible-designated-beneficiary rules.
steps.inputs: Participant birth dates and employment status, ownership data, beneficiary account records
steps.outputs: Annual RMD-eligible population, required beginning date assignments, exception flags

steps.name: Calculate Annual RMD Amounts
steps.description: Compute each required minimum distribution from the prior December 31 balance and the applicable IRS life-expectancy table (Uniform Lifetime, Joint Life for much-younger spouse, Single Life for beneficiaries), netting amounts already distributed in the year.
steps.inputs: Prior year-end balances, IRS life-expectancy tables, year-to-date distributions
steps.outputs: Calculated RMD amounts, remaining-amount tracking, calculation audit trail
steps.deliverable: Annual RMD calculation and payment schedule

steps.name: Notify Participants & Capture Payment Elections
steps.description: Send RMD notification packages with amount, deadline and withholding options, capture payment frequency and withholding elections, and configure automatic payment instructions for participants who do not respond.
steps.inputs: Calculated RMD amounts, participant contact data, withholding election forms
steps.outputs: Delivered RMD notices, captured payment elections, default payment instructions

steps.name: Process RMD Payments by Statutory Deadlines
steps.description: Disburse required amounts by December 31 (April 1 of the following year for a participant's first RMD), apply withholding, force automatic payments for non-responders before the deadline, and issue 1099-R reporting.
steps.inputs: Payment elections and defaults, RMD payment schedule, payee banking details
steps.outputs: Disbursed RMD payments, deadline compliance log, 1099-R records

steps.name: Track Missed RMDs & Initiate Corrections
steps.description: Identify RMDs not fully distributed by deadline, calculate the shortfall, process corrective distributions promptly to qualify for the reduced 10% excise rate (versus 25%) under SECURE 2.0, and support participant Form 5329 waiver requests and EPCRS correction where systemic.
steps.inputs: RMD completion report, missed-amount calculations, EPCRS correction procedures
steps.outputs: Corrective distributions, excise-tax exposure report, correction documentation

steps.name: Collect & Scrub Annual Census Data
steps.description: Obtain the plan-year census from each sponsor, validate compensation against the plan's 414(s) definition, identify ownership and family attribution for HCE/key-employee determination, and resolve data gaps before testing.
steps.supporting: Data Quality Manager, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Sponsor census file, compensation definitions, ownership and officer data
steps.outputs: Scrubbed census data, HCE and key-employee determinations, data exception log

steps.name: Run Coverage, ADP/ACP & Top-Heavy Tests
steps.description: Execute IRC 410(b) coverage, 401(k) ADP and 401(m) ACP nondiscrimination tests (or confirm safe-harbor status) and the 416 top-heavy determination, document pass/fail results and required corrective amounts.
steps.supporting: Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist, Retirement Operations Administrator
steps.inputs: Scrubbed census data, deferral and match totals, plan safe-harbor provisions
steps.outputs: Test results, failure determinations, corrective amount calculations
steps.deliverable: Annual nondiscrimination and limit testing results package

steps.name: Monitor 402(g) & 415 Contribution Limits
steps.description: Monitor individual elective deferrals against the 402(g) annual limit (with age-50 and SECURE 2.0 age 60-63 catch-ups) and total annual additions against the 415(c) limit throughout the year, stopping or recharacterizing excesses.
steps.inputs: Year-to-date contribution totals, IRS annual limits, catch-up eligibility data
steps.outputs: Limit monitoring alerts, excess deferral identifications, stopped or recharacterized contributions

steps.name: Process Corrective Distributions & Refunds
steps.description: Calculate and distribute excess contributions and excess aggregate contributions with allocable earnings within 2.5 months after plan year end (6 months for EACAs) to avoid the employer 10% excise tax, and issue corrected tax reporting.
steps.inputs: Failure determinations, corrective amount calculations, earnings allocation method
steps.outputs: Corrective distributions with earnings, excise-tax avoidance confirmation, 1099-R records

steps.name: Support EPCRS Corrections & VCP Filings
steps.description: For operational failures found in testing or operations, determine the correction path under EPCRS (self-correction vs. Voluntary Correction Program), prepare correction calculations and documentation, and support sponsor counsel on VCP submissions.
steps.inputs: Identified operational failures, EPCRS correction methods, plan document provisions
steps.outputs: Correction determinations, correction calculations, VCP submission support package

l4s.name: Form 5500 filing and plan audit support

steps.name: Compile Plan-Year Financial & Participant Data
steps.description: Assemble the certified trust financial statements, participant counts (including the beginning-of-year balance-based audit threshold), contribution and distribution totals, and service-provider fee data needed for Form 5500 and schedules.
steps.inputs: Trust financial statements, participant count data, transaction totals, fee data
steps.outputs: Plan-year financial package, participant count certification, schedule source data

steps.name: Prepare Form 5500 & Supporting Schedules
steps.description: Draft the Form 5500 (or 5500-SF) with Schedules A, C, H/I and R as applicable plus the Form 8955-SSA for separated participants with deferred benefits, and route to the plan administrator for review and signature ahead of the last-day-of-7th-month deadline (Form 5558 extension where needed).
steps.inputs: Plan-year financial package, schedule source data, prior-year filing
steps.outputs: Draft Form 5500 and schedules, Form 8955-SSA, extension filings where needed

steps.name: Coordinate Independent Plan Audit Support
steps.description: For large plans requiring an independent qualified public accountant audit, fulfill auditor data requests (participant samples, distribution support, SOC 1 report), resolve findings, and attach the audit opinion to the filing.
steps.inputs: Auditor request lists, participant transaction samples, SOC 1 report
steps.outputs: Fulfilled audit requests, resolved findings, attached audit opinion

steps.name: Submit Filing via EFAST2 & Track Acceptance
steps.description: Electronically file the signed Form 5500 through DOL EFAST2, monitor for acceptance or edit-check errors, remediate rejections, and archive the filed return with acknowledgment.
steps.inputs: Signed Form 5500 filing package, EFAST2 credentials, edit-check results
steps.outputs: Accepted EFAST2 filing, acknowledgment receipt, archived filing record

steps.name: Distribute Summary Annual Report
steps.description: Generate the Summary Annual Report from the filed Form 5500 and distribute it to participants and beneficiaries within nine months of plan year end (or two months after an extended filing).
steps.inputs: Accepted Form 5500 filing, SAR template, participant delivery preferences
steps.outputs: Distributed Summary Annual Reports, delivery confirmations

l4s.name: Fee disclosure and participant notice administration

steps.name: Compile Plan & Investment Fee Data
steps.description: Gather administrative and individual-transaction fee schedules, investment expense ratios, revenue-sharing arrangements and performance/benchmark data across the lineup as the single source for participant and sponsor fee disclosures.
steps.inputs: Service fee schedules, fund expense and performance data, revenue-sharing agreements
steps.outputs: Consolidated fee data set, investment comparative data, benchmark mappings

steps.name: Produce & Deliver 404(a)(5) Participant Fee Disclosures
steps.description: Produce the ERISA 404(a)(5) participant disclosure — plan-level and individual fee descriptions plus the investment comparative chart — deliver initially and annually (within the 14-month window) and on fee changes, and feed actual quarterly fee amounts to benefit statements.
steps.inputs: Consolidated fee data set, comparative chart template, participant delivery preferences
steps.outputs: Delivered 404(a)(5) disclosures, quarterly fee statement feed, delivery evidence

steps.name: Issue 408(b)(2) Service-Provider Disclosures to Sponsors
steps.description: Prepare and deliver the ERISA 408(b)(2) covered-service-provider disclosure to each plan fiduciary — services, fiduciary/RIA status, direct and indirect compensation — refreshing within 60 days of any compensation change to preserve the prohibited-transaction exemption.
steps.inputs: Service agreements, direct and indirect compensation data, fiduciary status designations
steps.outputs: Delivered 408(b)(2) disclosures, change-notice updates, disclosure delivery log

steps.name: Distribute Annual Plan Notices
steps.description: Generate and deliver the annual notice suite by statutory deadlines: 401(k) safe-harbor notice, QDIA notice, automatic-enrollment (EACA/QACA) notices, and summary of material modifications when plan terms change.
steps.inputs: Plan provision data, notice templates, statutory deadline calendar
steps.outputs: Delivered annual notices, deadline compliance log, returned-mail exceptions

steps.name: Track Delivery Evidence & Remediate Disclosure Failures
steps.description: Maintain auditable delivery evidence across paper and the 2020 DOL electronic-delivery safe harbor (initial paper notice, valid e-addresses, access monitoring), cure bounced deliveries, and remediate missed or late disclosures with documented corrective delivery.
steps.inputs: Delivery logs, e-delivery bounce reports, disclosure deadline calendar
steps.outputs: Delivery evidence archive, cured delivery failures, remediation documentation

notes: Relocations: none of the steps in life-relocations.json carry design hints pointing at Retirement Plan Administration (hints target FNOL capture and triage in Claims Intake-to-Settlement, Life and annuity in-force transaction servicing CI-04-05, and Life & Annuity New Business Underwriting CI-06-05). Zero relocated steps were absorbed into this stream.

Shared-stream references (checked against vs-outline.json): enterprise sanctions/AML program ownership = Risk & Compliance RC-20-05 — but a payee OFAC screening step is kept in-flow in 'Termination distribution and rollover processing' because OFAC requires pre-disbursement screening, mirroring the pattern in CI-04-05-S03; escheatment/unclaimed property remittance = Finance F-11-05 — the missing-participant step here produces an escheatment hand-off file rather than duplicating the state remittance process; first-line contact intake and formal complaints = Customer Service OC-14-01/03 — participant servicing here starts from escalated cases; general cash application = Billing CI-01-02 — contribution funding reconciliation is kept in-flow because 29 CFR 2510.3-102 plan-asset segregation timing regulates it (noted in the step).

Rollover best-interest documentation (DOL PTE 2020-02) is an in-flow regulatory step; it parallels the suitability reviews homed in CI-04-05-S02 and CI-06-05-S02 but applies plan-to-IRA rollover-specific fee-comparison and reasons documentation, so it is not a duplicate.

Naming: all four L3s (Plan Onboarding & Recordkeeping; Contribution Processing & Daily Valuation; Participant Distributions, Loans & Required Payouts; Plan Compliance, Reporting & Disclosure Support) are retirement-specific and collide with no L3/L4 name in vs-outline.json (verified by exact-match scan of all 29 streams).

Roles: all leads/supporting are verbatim from role-inventory.json, leaning on the Life & Retirement set — Retirement Recordkeeping Specialist and Retirement Operations Administrator lead most steps as day-to-day doers, with Annuity Suitability Analyst (rollover best interest), Annuity Service Specialist, Life Claims Examiner (death claims), Payment Processing Clerk, Compliance Analyst, Tax Analyst and Cash Application Specialist in specialist steps; no executives lead.

Systems of record: the app inventory has no dedicated retirement recordkeeping system, so Policy Administration Platform is used as the recordkeeping SoR for account/allocation/RMD/reconciliation deliverables; other deliverables map to Document & Forms Management (QDRO letter, 404(a)(5) package), Payment Gateway (disbursement/1099-R), E-Signature (loan agreement), Regulatory Filing Portal (Form 5500/EFAST2), Data & Analytics Platform (testing package).

Regulatory anchors verified by web research: 29 CFR 2510.3-102 deposit timing incl. 7-business-day small-plan safe harbor (https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/29/2510.3-102, https://www.truckerhuss.com/2010/02/dol-issues-final-regulation-creating-optional-7-business-day-safe-harbor-period-for-small-plans/); RMD applicable age 73 under SECURE 2.0 (https://www.irs.gov/retirement-plans/plan-participant-employee/retirement-topics-required-minimum-distributions-rmds); recordkeeper end-to-end scope — contributions, distributions, loans, hardships, RMDs, testing and 5500 support (https://www.standard.com/brokers-advisors/retirement/in-the-loop/setting-record-straight-role-recordkeeper, https://www.congruentsolutions.com/blogposts/a-compliance-guide-for-recordkeepers-and-plan-administrators-in-2024/). Other anchors applied: ERISA 101(i) blackout notice (30-60 days), 402(f) special tax notice + 20% mandatory withholding, SECURE 2.0 $7,000 force-out/auto-rollover threshold, IRC 72(p) loan limits and cure period, IRS hardship safe-harbor events with SECURE 2.0 self-certification, ADP/ACP-410(b)-416 testing with 2.5-month corrective window, Form 5500/EFAST2 + SAR 9-month deadline, ERISA 404(a)(5)/408(b)(2) disclosures, ERISA 206(d)(3) QDRO procedures, DOL missing-participant guidance and 2020 e-delivery safe harbor.

Scope coverage check vs. brief: plan onboarding/conversion (L4 1.1), recordkeeping (1.2), participant servicing (1.3), contribution processing (2.1), distributions & rollovers (3.1), loans & hardships (3.2), RMD administration (3.3), nondiscrimination/compliance testing (4.1), Form 5500 support (4.2), fee disclosure 404a-5/408b-2 (4.3) — all covered; trade settlement/reconciliation (2.2) added because daily valuation recordkeeping requires it.

Renamed to 'Screen Distribution Payees Against Sanctions Lists', matching the established per-context naming pattern (cf. 'Screen Claim Payees Against Sanctions Lists' CI-02-04, 'Screen Outbound Treasury Payments Against Sanctions Lists' F-11-03, 'Screen Vendor Against Sanctions & Watchlists' OC-13-01). Step content unchanged — in-flow pre-disbursement OFAC screening remains required, with program ownership in RC-20-05.
